title: Enabling Upcoming Features Ahead of Time

facts.text: Optional features can be enabled ahead of time on sandbox and production environments before becoming mandatory.
Generally available features are ready for use and follow standard support lifecycle rules.
Navigate to Feature Management page, choose Edit List if needed, then set Enabled for field to All users.
Use Try it out link to test a feature in a new browser session without enabling it for all users.
Assign FEATURE MGT. - ADMIN permission set to allow users to enable optional features.
Some features require other features to be enabled first and show prerequisites indented in the list.
Optional features cannot be enabled for single users; enabled features apply to all users in the environment.
Irreversible features permanently affect Business Central capabilities and cannot be disabled after enabling.
